kjv: Howbeit this kind goeth not out but by prayer and fasting.
note: TR's 17:21 ("touto de to genos ouk ekporeuetai ei me en proseuche kai nesteia") is imported from Mark 9:29 (itself with "and fasting" added); it is absent from Sinaiticus, Vaticanus, Theta and early versions.
TR "apistian" ("unbelief") against "oligopistian" ("little faith") in Sinaiticus and Vaticanus; the rare word fits Matthew's usage (6:30, 8:26, 14:31, 16:8).

kjv: he is lunatick, and sore vexed
mine: he has seizures and he suffers terribly
note: seleniazetai describes epileptic seizures (falling into fire and water); "lunatic" now means insane.
